item.title: Kings Could Target Top Trade Candidate As Kopitar Replacement

item.title: Canadiens Trade Rumors: 4 Teams Listed As Patrik Laine Landing Spots
item.description: We're still two weeks away from NHL rosters being taken out of the deep freeze, but that doesn't mean that teams aren't having conversations.
